product_family: BambooHR all-in-one HR platform (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits Administration, Time & Attendance, Applicant Tracking System, Performance Management, Onboarding, Compensation Management, Bamboo AI, Global Employment/EOR, Compliance Training)

certifications.proof_quote: SOC 1 Type 2 Report - 2025 [listed as available document requiring NDA access]

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 2 Report - 2025 [listed as available document requiring NDA access]; security page states 'Annual third-party SOC I & II security audit'

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI DSS Compliance Certificate [listed as available document in Trust Center]

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: EU - US DPF [listed as active certification on Trust Center profile]

certifications.proof_quote: UK Extension to EU-US DPF [listed as active certification on Trust Center profile]

certifications.proof_quote: Swiss-US DPF [listed as active certification on Trust Center profile]

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Not listed as a held certification. DPA references ISO 27001 as a standard BambooHR maintains records 'in accordance with', but BambooHR does not claim an ISO 27001 certificate on its Trust Center.

certifications.name: HIPAA BAA
certifications.proof_quote: BambooHR does have a Business Associate Agreement Addendum (BAA) that complies with HIPAA 1996 and the HITECH Act of 2009. Applies only to 'Qualifying Services' that involve Protected Health Information.

privacy.ai_training_note: BambooHR explicitly states it does not use customer data to train proprietary or third-party AI models. The AI Addendum clarifies that if BambooHR fine-tunes models using a customer's data for that customer's AI features (Bamboo AI), the resulting model is scoped only to that customer and is never used to serve other customers. BambooHR may use aggregated, anonymized customer data for HR benchmarking features (displayed only when at least 5 companies are represented to protect anonymity). Developer/integration partners are contractually prohibited from using BambooHR customer data to train any ML model.
privacy.data_region: United States, Canada, Ireland (EU). Customers outside North America are hosted in Ireland, which meets EU/EEA/Switzerland/UK data requirements.

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: Active. BambooHR's security page confirms an 'Active bug bounty program.' Trust Center lists 'Responsible Disclosure' as a security control. Specific platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) not publicly confirmed; historical reports exist via Open Bug Bounty from third-party researchers.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration test. Trust Center includes pen test customer letters for 2023, 2024, and 2025 (available under NDA).

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Encryption in transit and at rest. 'Highest industry standard encryption.'

security.name: Security model
security.value: Defense in Depth and Zero Trust

security.name: Data hosting
security.value: State-of-the-art data centers in United States, Canada, and Ireland. Ireland facility meets EU/EEA/Switzerland/UK data requirements.

products.name: Core HR (HRIS)
products.data_scope: Employee personal data, org structure, PTO, job and pay history. Processed as data processor under DPA. Customer is data controller.
products.notes: Base product required for all other modules. Serves 30,000+ businesses.

products.name: Payroll
products.data_scope: Compensation, tax, banking, and payroll data. PCI DSS applies to payment card data.
products.notes: US payroll only. SOC 1 and SOC 2 in scope.

products.name: Benefits Administration
products.data_scope: Health and benefits elections; may involve PHI covered under BAA.
products.notes: HIPAA BAA available for qualifying services involving PHI.

products.name: Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
products.data_scope: Candidate PII: resumes, contact details, application history.
products.notes: GDPR/CCPA data subject rights apply to candidate data.

products.name: Bamboo AI
products.data_scope: Accesses existing HR data within customer's BambooHR account. Covers Ask BambooHR (instant HR Q&A) and eNPS AI Topic Summaries.
products.notes: Governed by AI Addendum. Customer data not used to train shared models. Performance data and customer feedback may improve that customer's AI features. AI subcontractors listed in Trust Center subcontractor list.

products.name: Global Employment / Employer of Record (EOR)
products.data_scope: International employee data, multi-jurisdictional payroll, compliance records.
products.notes: Data residency and legal compliance vary by country. Expanding product line.

products.name: HR Benchmarks (Data at Work)
products.data_scope: Aggregated, anonymized data pooled across customers. Benchmark shown only when at least 5 companies are represented.
products.notes: This is a notable secondary data use: customer data contributes to cross-customer benchmarks. Anonymization protections are in place per published Data Principles.

compare.pricing_model: Per employee per month (PEPM), flat monthly rate for companies under 25 employees. Volume discounts automatically applied as headcount increases. Exact rates require a demo/quote.
compare.data_residency: US, Canada, Ireland. EU customers default to Ireland. No customer-selected residency option documented.

flags: BambooHR aggregates and anonymizes customer data across its customer base to produce HR benchmarking reports and the 'Data at Work' product. While protected by anonymization thresholds (a minimum of 5 companies), procurement teams should be aware this is a documented secondary use of their HR data.

The AI Principles page states BambooHR does not train AI models on customer data. However, the AI Addendum permits fine-tuning for a specific customer's own AI features, scoped only to that customer, so buyers should review the AI Addendum closely.
The security page confirms an active bug bounty program but does not name the platform (HackerOne or Bugcrowd). Confirm the responsible disclosure email and details via trust.bamboohr.com.
Despite common vendor comparison expectations, BambooHR does not hold ISO 27001 certification. Their SOC 2 Type 2 covers similar ground for US enterprise buyers.
